Class LessonsCrudTestingAutomation

java.lang.Object
testingAutomation.LessonsCrudTestingAutomation
public class LessonsCrudTestingAutomation extends Object

Title: LessonsCrudTestingAutomation Class.

Description: Semi-automated tests for the persistent Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations of LessonsLearned and LessonsLearnedList, and for the storage they rely on in LessonsLearnedDatabase. Requirements covered: CS-1 (create), CS-3 (read by id), CS-7 (update), CS-8 (delete), CS-9 (ownership test), and CS-12 (lessons persist across restarts).

Three kinds of database are used, each for a stated reason:

  • CRUD-01 to CRUD-10 use a private in-memory database, so the developer's own FoundationDatabase file is never touched.
  • CRUD-11 and CRUD-12 use a database file in a new temporary folder. An in-memory database cannot show persistence, so these tests close the connection and open a new one on the same file, which is what restarting the application does.
  • CRUD-13 and CRUD-14 build the table layout an HW2 solution left behind (author, body, tags, createdAt) and then open it the way FoundationsMain does. Before the fix this made every save and every read fail with "Column DESCRIPTION not found".

Each test is one private method named after its id, whose Javadoc states the requirement, how the test exercises the code, and the condition for a Pass. The tests run in id order because later ones use the lesson the earlier ones stored.

How to read the output: one "Pass:" or "Failure:" line per test id, then the suite totals. A "SETUP FAILED" line means a database could not be opened and the tests that needed it were counted as failures.

    • crud01CreateValidLesson

      private static void crud01CreateValidLesson(database.LessonsLearnedDatabase db)

      CRUD-01 (CS-1, positive). A valid lesson is stored and given an identifier.

      How: LessonsLearned.create validates the lesson, writes it with LessonsLearnedDatabase.addLesson, and records the generated key in the object. The stored row count is read before and after.

      Pass when: create returns null, the lesson's id is greater than 0, and the count has gone up by exactly one.

      Parameters:
      db - the in-memory database

    • crud02CreateBlankTitleRefused

      private static void crud02CreateBlankTitleRefused(database.LessonsLearnedDatabase db)

      CRUD-02 (CS-1, negative). A lesson with a blank title is refused and nothing is written.

      How: create is called on a lesson whose title is "". validate runs before addLesson, so the database should never see the row.

      Pass when: create returns "The title is required", the lesson's id is still -1, and the stored row count has not changed.

      Parameters:
      db - the in-memory database

    • crud03ReadById

      private static void crud03ReadById(database.LessonsLearnedDatabase db)

      CRUD-03 (CS-3, positive). The lesson stored by CRUD-01 can be read back by its id with every field intact.

      How: LessonsLearned.read(db, id) runs a SELECT by id and rebuilds the object.

      Pass when: the lesson read back has the same title, category, contributor, and keywords, and a creation date has been recorded.

      Parameters:
      db - the in-memory database

    • crud04ReadUnknownId

      private static void crud04ReadUnknownId(database.LessonsLearnedDatabase db)

      CRUD-04 (CS-3, negative). Reading an identifier that was never stored returns null rather than throwing an exception or returning an empty lesson.

      How: read is called with id 99999.

      Pass when: read returns null.

      Parameters:
      db - the in-memory database

    • crud05UpdatePersists

      private static void crud05UpdatePersists(database.LessonsLearnedDatabase db)

      CRUD-05 (CS-7, positive). A changed title is written to the database, and the contributor and creation date are not changed by the update.

      How: the title is changed with setTitle and update is called. The lesson is then read again from the database, not from the object in memory.

      Pass when: update returns null, the re-read lesson has the new title, and its contributor and creation date equal the originals.

      Parameters:
      db - the in-memory database

    • crud06UpdateBlankTitleRefused

      private static void crud06UpdateBlankTitleRefused(database.LessonsLearnedDatabase db)

      CRUD-06 (CS-7, negative). An update to a blank title is refused and the stored lesson keeps its previous title, because update applies the same validation as create.

      How: a freshly read copy has its title set to "" and update is called.

      Pass when: update returns "The title is required" and the stored title is still the one CRUD-05 wrote.

      Parameters:
      db - the in-memory database

    • crud07Delete

      private static void crud07Delete(database.LessonsLearnedDatabase db)

      CRUD-07 (CS-8, positive). A stored lesson is deleted and can no longer be read.

      How: delete is called on the CRUD-01 lesson; read is then called with its old id.

      Pass when: delete returns true and read returns null.

      Parameters:

    • crud10NonOwnerNotRecognised

      private static void crud10NonOwnerNotRecognised()

      CRUD-10 (CS-9, negative). isOwnedBy refuses any other account, including the same name in a different case and a null username.

      How: isOwnedBy is called with "arushugal", "KaranPatel", and null.

    • crud11And12PersistAcrossReopen

      private static void crud11And12PersistAcrossReopen()

      CRUD-11 (CS-12, positive) and CRUD-12 (CS-12, negative). A lesson written before the database is closed is still there when it is opened again, and a lesson deleted before closing is still gone.

      How: a database file is created in a new temporary folder. Two lessons are stored and one of them is deleted. The connection is then closed, which is what quitting the application does, and a brand new LessonsLearnedDatabase object is connected to the same file, which is what starting it again does. The folder is removed afterwards.

      Pass when, for CRUD-11: the kept lesson is read back after reopening with its title and contributor. For CRUD-12: reading the deleted lesson's id after reopening returns null and exactly one lesson is stored.

    • crud13And14OpenHw2Layout

      private static void crud13And14OpenHw2Layout()

      CRUD-13 (CS-12, positive) and CRUD-14 (CS-12, negative). The application still saves and lists lessons when the database already holds an HW2 lessonsLearned table with different columns, and the HW2 rows are kept rather than lost.

      How: plain JDBC creates the HW2 layout (author, title, body, tags, category, createdAt) in a new in-memory database and inserts one HW2 row. LessonsLearnedDatabase then connects to it, as FoundationsMain does at start up, which renames the HW2 table to LEGACY_TABLE and creates the TP2 table. A lesson is then created and the list is read.

      Pass when, for CRUD-13: create returns null and readAll returns exactly that one lesson. For CRUD-14: the renamed table still holds the one HW2 row, so nothing written by HW2 was deleted.
